name: taskman-settings
description: Read or write Task Manager's settings (namespace taskman-settings).

action.description: read every row, or write one.

key.description: dense — Dense rows (switch); crossOutDone — Cross out completed items (switch); confirmDelete — Confirm destructive deletes (switch); autoBuildLists — Auto-add build project lists (switch); autoModuleLists — Auto-add module lists (switch)

value.description: The new value when writing; matches the row's declared kind.
